boardObjectives.label: Sign someone 21 or under rated 85 or better
Have 13 players from England in the squad

inbox.text: International break: the window runs 21 Sep to 6 Oct, and your fixtures do not stop for it, so they went straight after your last game. Away with their countries (England: Jarrad Branthwaite and James Garner; Wales: Brennan Johnson; Ukraine: Vitaliy Mykolenko; Ireland: Jake O'Brien and Mark Travers). They are back for the Manchester City game. Brennan Johnson, Vitaliy Mykolenko and Jake O'Brien started for their countries, the rest mostly watched from the bench. Your assistant wants to know: start them against Manchester City, or rest the spent ones for that one game?

options.label: Rest the ones who are spent

inbox.resolved: That game has been and gone.

inbox.text: One of your forwards wants the club to sign his brother. His brother is 34 and plays Sunday league, and is reportedly in the best shape of his life.

options.label: Offer a trial, for the content

inbox.text: Your assistant has been watching the under 21s. 3 of them are still improving and the plan is not pointed at them. He wants the week built around the kids.

options.label: Point the week at the kids

inbox.text: One of your defenders challenged a fan who criticized him to a race. The fan won. It is everywhere.

options.label: Sign the fan for the youth team

pending.text: 4 defeats in your last 5. Have you lost the dressing room?

options.label: These players are with me
options.line: You put your arm round the lot of them in public. Upstairs, that read as excuses.

options.label: That one is on me
options.line: You took it on the chin. The board respect it. The press smell a man under pressure.

options.label: Some of them were not at it
options.line: You named no names and everybody knew who you meant. It went round the dressing room by teatime.

options.label: We go again Saturday
options.line: Four words and a walk out. They will find something else to write about.

decisions.text: A columnist has written that your side has no plan. The press officer wants to know whether you will answer it.
decisions.resolved: Nobody answered before the next match, so nothing changed.

decisions.text: The head coach flags Carlos Alcaraz: his morale is down at 46, the lowest in the first team squad, and a word from the manager would help.
decisions.resolved: Nobody answered before the next match, so nothing changed.

decisions.text: A local school has asked for a first team visit, and the community department would like the manager to front it. The board like to see the manager doing this sort of thing.
decisions.resolved: Nobody answered before the next match, so nothing changed.

decisions.text: A sponsor wants the squad at a photo shoot on the day off and will pay £200k for the afternoon. The supporters trust has asked for the same afternoon for an open day at the training ground, and the local paper wants to cover it.
decisions.resolved: Nobody answered before the next match, so nothing changed.
